findings.title: Client first-seen/baseline NEW rule still shipped instead of server createdAt rule
findings.detail: NewBadgePolicy.isNewCandidate reads state.firstSeen and compares it with BASELINE, and syncCatalog writes first_seen_at. The report cites a 'Quyết định user (vòng 3)' that does not appear in the user's messages. Per the brief, a missing createdAt must be reported as a warning; it must not be replaced with the rejected fallback.
findings.action: Remove syncCatalog, firstSeen, BASELINE and their call sites. Change isNewCandidate to template.createdAt > 0 && (now - createdAt).coerceAtLeast(0) <= 7d. Narrow the entity to opened codes only (template_code PK, opened_at NOT NULL) and expose StateFlow<Set<String>>. Regenerate the migration8To9 CREATE TABLE to match the Room DDL and re-run the seeded v8->v9 favorites check. Escalate to the user that the API currently returns no createdAt, so NEW stays hidden until the backend adds it.

findings.title: createdAt parsing still optLong (ISO strings silently become 0)
findings.detail: Line 567: obj.optLong("createdAt", 0L). An ISO-8601 string produces 0, so NEW would never show even after the backend adds the field.
findings.action: Parse createdAt/created_at as a number, a numeric string, or ISO-8601. For ISO, use SimpleDateFormat with UTC and Locale.US, with and without millis, and create the formatter once per catalog parse. Do not use java.time. Fall back to 0L.

findings.title: Video icon removed instead of moved to bottom-right
findings.detail: User message 2, item 3 asks for the video icon to move to bottom-right. ivVideoIndicator is absent from both card layouts (removed in cd0ce5b). The header comment now says 'no video indicator', which records the deviation but does not resolve it.
findings.action: Restore the video icon at bottom-right with its existing visibility, toggled both ways in bind, or get explicit user confirmation that cd0ce5b supersedes the decision.

findings.title: Hardcoded dp in uncommitted Discover NEW pill restyle
findings.detail: The uncommitted diff replaces @dimen/template_badge_height with literal 6dp/2dp padding and a 6dp margin.
findings.action: Reuse the Home card's badge tokens or snap to @dimen/spacing_* tokens.
